sam_people_ops: Quick proposal: new "stagger + safeguard" flow for the performance mid-cycle to avoid reviewer spikes and give calibration earlier signals. Need sign-off today so reminders go out.

anya_engineering_mgr: Quick Q: what about teams under 5? we usually prefer one pass.

sam_people_ops: Good point. Rule: teams <=5 stay single-deadline. Stagger applies to teams >5.

juju_people_ops: Outline of flow:
- Notify (Day 0) + CSV with tags (early-signal / baseline / edge)
- Reminder Day 2
- Day 3: 60% due for large teams
- Day 4: Signal Check (2x timezone runs)
- Day 7: remaining due
- Day 8: Consensus calibration session

sam_people_ops: Early-signal tagging = customer-facing ICs, recent launch leads, and cross-team PM partners. Managers can override tags in the sheet.

mark_sre: For ops, can we reserve one APAC-friendly slot for calibration? otherwise our east teams can't join.

sam_people_ops: Yes  Signal Check will run at 07:30 PST and 19:00 PST. Calendar invites will be sent.

juju_people_ops: Ops will run QA: 8 random spot-checks per manager before calibration and flag any outliers. Also add a reviewer checklist in reminders: impact, objectives alignment, evidence, and calibration note.

ops-bot: Automated reminders scheduled: Day 2, Day 6, Final day. Calendar invites queued.

anya_engineering_mgr: Sounds fine. Please exclude brand-new hires (start <2 weeks) from early-signal sampling.

sam_people_ops: Will do. If no objections by EOD I'll publish the flow and open the opt-in for accelerated teams. :white_check_mark:
